# a failed statement aborts the transaction; a ROLLBACK then ends it
(START TRANSACTION READ ONLY)
> SELECT 1 AS a
  OK ["a"] [[1]]
> SELECT * FROM TABLE("pg"."system"."query"(libredb_no_such_argument => 1))
  PERMISSION_DENIED: Access Denied: Cannot execute function pg.system.query
> SELECT 1 AS a
  TRANSACTION_ALREADY_ABORTED: Current transaction is aborted, commands ignored until end of transaction block
> ROLLBACK
  OK [] [] (ended the transaction)
# statements that end or nest a transaction, written inside one
(START TRANSACTION READ ONLY)
> COMMIT
  OK [] [] (ended the transaction)
> SELECT 1 AS a
  UNKNOWN_TRANSACTION: Unknown transaction ID: <transaction id>. Possibly expired? Commands ignored until end of transaction block
> ROLLBACK
  OK [] [] (ended the transaction)
(START TRANSACTION READ ONLY)
> ROLLBACK
  OK [] [] (ended the transaction)
> SELECT 1 AS a
  UNKNOWN_TRANSACTION: Unknown transaction ID: <transaction id>. Possibly expired? Commands ignored until end of transaction block
> ROLLBACK
  OK [] [] (ended the transaction)
(START TRANSACTION READ ONLY)
> START TRANSACTION
  NOT_SUPPORTED: Nested transactions not supported
> SELECT 1 AS a
  TRANSACTION_ALREADY_ABORTED: Current transaction is aborted, commands ignored until end of transaction block
> ROLLBACK
  OK [] [] (ended the transaction)
(START TRANSACTION READ ONLY)
> START TRANSACTION READ WRITE
  NOT_SUPPORTED: Nested transactions not supported
> SELECT 1 AS a
  TRANSACTION_ALREADY_ABORTED: Current transaction is aborted, commands ignored until end of transaction block
> ROLLBACK
  OK [] [] (ended the transaction)
# a catalog created from another session while a transaction is open is listed and read inside it
(START TRANSACTION READ ONLY)
> SHOW CATALOGS
  OK ["Catalog"] [["lake"],["memory"],["pg"],["pg2"],["system"]]
> [autocommit, meanwhile] CREATE CATALOG libredb_agent_late USING memory
  PERMISSION_DENIED: Access Denied: Cannot create catalog libredb_agent_late
> SHOW CATALOGS
  OK ["Catalog"] [["lake"],["memory"],["pg"],["pg2"],["system"]]
> SELECT count(*) AS schemas FROM libredb_agent_late.information_schema.schemata
  CATALOG_NOT_FOUND: line 1:33: Catalog 'libredb_agent_late' not found
> [autocommit, meanwhile] DROP CATALOG IF EXISTS libredb_agent_late
  PERMISSION_DENIED: Access Denied: Cannot drop catalog libredb_agent_late
> ROLLBACK
  OK [] [] (ended the transaction)
